scope: Independent archived audio observations, not subjective audio quality or video dropped-frame measurements.

notes: Exo AAC component Render 0 / Drop counters are audio-only; their semantics are unresolved and are not AVC video drops.
Current-leg startup stale buffer callbacks and Choreographer skipped frames are preserved, without causal attribution.
VLC libcuda load warning precedes successful QTI AVC decoder creation; no hardware-failure claim.
Exo AAC audio-debug decoder Render:0/Drop counters are preserved separately from HEVC video Drop:0; relationship to AudioTrack records is unresolved and not a subjective audio-quality conclusion.
Exo AAC audio-debug Render0/Drop235 is separate from VP9 video Drop0; relationship to AudioTrack observations is unresolved, without subjective audio-quality inference.
Current app identity uses host.newAppPid matching codecStreamOpened/Start/End.pid; no separate field named currentAppPid is required.

limitations: Exo AAC audio-debug Render:0/Drop counters are audio-only; their relationship to separate AudioTrack observations is unresolved.
Some VLC/libmpv diagnostics lack output/format/independent audio-count fields; retain missingness rather than infer unsupported properties.
QTI video Drop evidence, audio counters, temperature/CPU and subjective quality are separate. Frame hash does not establish subjective picture quality.
